_constructed: every row below is authored in this folder; no model was run. A world where M yields no crossings, D yields several, M+ stays at M, and the control D reads native.

response:
DEFECT 1
quantity:   soil organic carbon stock to 30 cm
set:        paired plots, no-till vs conventional
defect:     Sampling stops at 30 cm, so carbon redistributed below the horizon by tillage is outside the set.

DEFECT 2
quantity:   SOC stock per hectare at fixed depth
set:        cores of fixed depth across treatments
defect:     Fixed-depth stocks differ under differing bulk density, so an equivalent-soil-mass basis is needed.

DEFECT 3
quantity:   change in SOC stock over the trial period
set:        trial duration per site
defect:     Trials of different length are pooled as if the rate were constant.

DEFECT 4
quantity:   pooled effect size of the SOC stock difference
set:        meta-analysis of paired trials
defect:     Pooling weights sites by reported variance, so a few long-run sites dominate.

DEFECT 5
quantity:   SOC concentration by dry combustion
set:        subsamples of each core
defect:     Dry combustion counts inorganic carbon in calcareous soils unless acid pretreatment is applied.

quantity:   tonnes of CO2-equivalent removed
measured_by_method:  partial
gap:        Converting Mg C to CO2e is a coefficient the method does not apply.

quantity:   net greenhouse gas balance including N2O and fuel use
measured_by_method:  no
gap:        No-till changes N2O flux and fuel use; the method measures neither.

quantity:   permanence-weighted tonne-years of storage
measured_by_method:  no
gap:        No re-sampling after the trial, so duration of storage is unmeasured.

quantity:   additional sequestration relative to a counterfactual baseline
measured_by_method:  no
gap:        The paired plot is a comparison, not a crediting baseline.

quantity:   whole-profile soil organic carbon stock to 1 m
measured_by_method:  partial
gap:        Cores stop at 30 cm.

quantity:   leakage of emissions displaced off-site
measured_by_method:  no
gap:        Nothing in the trial follows displaced production.
decision: agricultural carbon credit issuance and climate mitigation targets

DEFECT 1
quantity:   particle count per gram tissue
set:        tissue samples per organ
defect:     Digestion recovery is not verified with spiked controls.

DEFECT 2
quantity:   polymer mass per gram wet tissue
set:        wet-weight normalised samples
defect:     Wet weight varies with post-mortem interval, moving the denominator.

DEFECT 3
quantity:   particle count in archived samples of different vintage
set:        archived tissue by collection year
defect:     Older archives were stored in plastic containers, so vintage and contamination covary.

DEFECT 4
quantity:   particle count above the instrument size limit
set:        particles resolvable by micro-FTIR
defect:     Particles below the size limit are absent from the count by construction.

DEFECT 5
quantity:   particle count in procedural blanks
set:        laboratory blanks per batch
defect:     Blank subtraction is not reported, so the count includes laboratory background.

quantity:   dose (particles ingested per day)
measured_by_method:  no
gap:        Tissue burden is a stock; intake per day is not measured.

quantity:   health risk
measured_by_method:  no

quantity:   exposure from food-contact materials
measured_by_method:  no
gap:        Tissue burden does not partition by source.

quantity:   migration of polymer from packaging into food
measured_by_method:  no
gap:        No packaging is sampled.

quantity:   polymer-specific hazard
measured_by_method:  no
gap:        Polymer identity is measured; hazard per polymer is not.
